topics.topic: Tsarin Jumla a Hausa: Sauƙaƙƙiyar jumla, sarƙaƙƙiyar jumla, da jimloli masu ma'ana
learningObjectives: Fahimtar tsarin gina jumla a nahawun Hausa (jigo, aikatau, da abin aiki)
Bambanta tsakanin sauƙaƙƙiyar jumla da sarƙaƙƙiyar jumla
Amfani da kalmomin haɗawa wajen tsawaita jimla

topics.topic: Irin Jimla Dangane da Aikinta: Sanarwa, tambaya, umarni, da tsegumi
learningObjectives: Raba jimloli bisa aikin da suke yi a magana
Koya yadda ake sanya alamar tambaya da alamar mamaki a wuraren da suka dace
Canza jumlar sanarwa zuwa jumlar tambaya ko umarni

topics.topic: Al'adun Mutuwa da Jana'iza a Ƙasar Hausa
learningObjectives: Bayyana yadda ake wanka, likfani, da sallar jana'iza a addinin Musulunci da al'ada
Koya yadda ake yin ta'aziyya da addu'o'i ga mamaci
Fahimtar hakkokin dangi da raba gado (mirasi) bisa koyarwar shari'a

topics.topic: Adabin Rubuce don Jarabawar BECE: Littafin kagaggen labari da zubin fasaha
learningObjectives: Karatun zaɓaɓɓen littafin karatu na BECE a aji
Nazarin salon rubutun marubuci da yadda ya yi amfani da karin magana
Fito da manyan darussa da ke taimaka wa matasa wajen zama mutanen kirki

topics.topic: Rubutun Muhawara (Insha'in Jayayya): "Aikin Gona Ya Fi Aikin Ofis Amfani"
learningObjectives: Koya ka'idojin rubuta insha'in muhawara
Kare ra'ayi tare da kafa kwararan hujjoji masu gamsarwa
Kauce wa cin mutuncin abokin muhawara cikin tsari da ladabi

topics.topic: Tsarin Sarautar Gargajiya a Ƙasar Hausa: Sarki, Hakimai, da Fadawa
learningObjectives: Bayyana matsayin Sarki da yadda ake naɗa shi a masarauta
Gane manyan muƙamai a fada (Waziri, Madaki, Galadima, Makama)
Bayyana rawar da masarautu ke takawa wajen zaman lafiya da ci gaba

topics.topic: Gwajin Tsakiyar Zango don Shirin Jarabawar BECE
learningObjectives: Auna matsayin shirin ɗalibai don jarabawar ƙarshe ta BECE
Gyara kuskuren jimloli da na insha'i
Ƙarfafa gwiwar ɗalibai wajen zama masu himma da hazaka

topics.topic: Hada Kalmomi da Raba Kalmomi a Nahawun Hausa
learningObjectives: Fahimtar ƙa'idojin haɗa kalmomin zamani a rubuce
Bambanta tsakanin kalmar da ake rubuta ta a dunƙule da wacce ake rabawa
Tabbatar da cewa rubutun ya bi ka'idar da Hukumar Bunkasa Harshen Hausa ta amince da ita

topics.topic: Wasannin Gargajiya a Ƙasar Hausa: Dambe, kokawa, da langa
learningObjectives: Gane tsofaffin wasannin motsa jiki a ƙasar Hausa
Bayyana muhimmancin dambe da kokawa wajen gwada jarumtaka da ƙarfi
Gane dokokin wasannin gargajiya da yadda suke haɗa kan al'umma

topics.topic: Ƙirƙirar Sababbin Kalmomi a Hausa don Fannin Kimiyya da Fasaha
learningObjectives: Fahimtar yadda ake aro kalmomi ko fassara su zuwa Hausa
Rubuta kalmomin kimiyya kamar kwamfuta, intanet, da wayar salula a Hausa
Haɓaka ilimin harshe don tafiya da zamani

topics.topic: Dokokin Zamantakewa da Al'adun Kula da Muhalli a Ƙasar Hausa
learningObjectives: Bayyana dokokin da al'ada ta tanada don tsaftar muhalli
Gane amfanin gina rijiyoyi, dasa bishiyoyi, da share magudanan ruwa
Kare muhalli daga hamada da zaizayar ƙasa

topics.topic: Cikakkiyar Bita don Shirin Jarabawar BECE / JSCE
learningObjectives: Duba dukkan fannonin jarrabawa: nahawu, insha'i, adabi, da al'ada
Koyar da dabarun amsa tambayoyi cikin sauri da natsuwa
Kawar da tsoro da fargaba a zukatan ɗalibai

topics.topic: Jarabawar Ƙarshen Zango da Gwajin Motsa Jiki na BECE
learningObjectives: Gudanar da cikakkiyar jarabawa mai daidaito da ta BECE
Tantance makin ɗalibai cikin adalci
Shigar da sakamako ga hukumar jarabawa ta jiha
